title: Smoky Mac 'n Cheese
description: A comforting, cheesy pasta dish with a smoky twist. This vegetarian take on a classic favorite is perfect for a cozy night in.
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Sprinkle the smoked paprika and cook for another minute.
Add the shredded mozzarella and grated parmesan to the saucepan.
Stir until the cheese is melted and well combined.
Add the cooked macaroni to the cheese sauce and stir until well coated.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the macaroni and cheese to a baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and bubbly.
